score_status=no_connection.recommended_zh: 未形成可用点序列（legacy no_connection）
score_status=no_connection.exact_native_definition: For the registered n>=3 pipeline: selected node count >=4 and candidate.points is None.
mechanism_requires_full_state: Whether a complete projected source ring exists under the exact native criterion
Whether every selected group has a resolved center
code_level_possible_paths: No complete projected source ring covering every selected node exactly once
Selected-node location unresolved, preventing assembly despite an available order
score_status=no_connection.observation_limit: The code-level branches are not claims that both were observed in this study. Individual examples are interpreted only from saved full_state.

A_connection_failure / C_connection_fail.definition: Existing boolean is exactly score_status == no_connection; retain its values and name for file compatibility.
A_connection_failure / C_connection_fail.recommended_zh: 未形成可用点序列标志（legacy no_connection）
A_connection_failure / C_connection_fail.must_not_label: Do not report this boolean alone as proof of a purely ring-connection cause.

A_fusion_structural_failure / C_fusion_s.definition: fusion_exception OR below_four OR no_connection, using the stored native status.
A_fusion_structural_failure / C_fusion_s.interpretation: A descriptive grouped incomplete-output indicator; no_connection inside it remains mechanistically unresolved without full_state.

A_fusion_failure_observed / C_fusion_fai.definition: The preceding grouped indicator OR invalid_floor OR invalid_full_geometry.
A_fusion_failure_observed / C_fusion_fai.interpretation: Keeps observed output failure distinct from measurement_exception, floor_only_reference and other missing-Q states; it is not a unique mechanism diagnosis.

geometry_centroid_distance_AC.definition: Euclidean distance between valid floor polygon centroids

exact_source_ring_criterion: Retained selected node count >=3, projected source sequence length equals retained count, and projected set equals retained set. Subset inclusion alone is insufficient.
